title: Understanding Bootstrapping
text: Bootstrapping involves resampling with replacement from the sample data to create 'new' samples. This helps in estimating the sampling distribution of a statistic.

title: Choosing the Statistic
text: When constructing bootstrapped estimates, you need to decide which statistic you want to estimate. In this case, it's the median.
